component.name: ProbeButton
component.script:
sub init() m.top.focusable = true m.top.observeFieldScoped("focusedChild", "onFocusedChildChange") end sub
sub onFocusedChildChange() fc = "invalid" if m.top.focusedChild <> invalid then fc = m.top.focusedChild.id print "PROBE|" + m.top.id + " focusedChild=" + fc + " hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() end sub
